title: HR Executive
description:
HR Executive – Roles and Responsibilities

- Manage end-to-end recruitment, including job postings, candidate screening, interview scheduling, and onboarding.
- Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, employee records, and other HR documentation.
- Coordinate joining formalities, document verification, employee induction, and orientation.
- Maintain attendance, leave records, employee information, and payroll-related data.
- Coordinate monthly payroll processing with the accounts or finance team.
- Monitor employee performance, probation periods, and confirmation processes.
- Communicate company policies, HR procedures, attendance rules, and workplace guidelines.
- Handle employee queries, grievances, and workplace concerns professionally.
- Coordinate employee engagement activities, training sessions, and internal communications.
- Monitor compliance with company policies and applicable employment regulations.
- Manage exit formalities, resignation documentation, exit interviews, and employee handovers.
- Prepare HR reports covering recruitment, attendance, employee turnover, and workforce status.
- Coordinate with department managers to identify staffing requirements and support workforce planning.
- Maintain confidentiality of employee records and sensitive HR information.

title: Relationship Manager
description: Manage relationships with prospective property owners, tenants, buyers, and sellers. Understand customer requirements, recommend suitable property solutions, coordinate property visits, and follow up with leads to drive successful closures. Maintain accurate CRM records, address customer queries, coordinate with internal teams, support negotiations and documentation, and achieve assigned sales targets while ensuring professional service and transparent communication.

title: Business Development Manager
description: Identify new business opportunities, develop lead generation strategies, and expand the company's customer base across property management, rentals, leasing, sales, and investments. Build relationships with property owners, tenants, buyers, investors, and business partners. Manage the sales pipeline, monitor lead conversion, support negotiations, and drive successful closures. Guide and coordinate with Business Development Executives and Relationship Managers to achieve team targets. Analyse market trends, identify growth opportunities, maintain accurate sales reports, prepare revenue forecasts, and report business performance to management. Ensure transparent customer communication and achieve assigned monthly revenue and business development targets.

title: Business Development Executive
description: Generate leads through property portals, online platforms, referrals, and other sources. Contact prospective property owners, tenants, buyers, and sellers to understand their requirements and introduce iGREY HOLDINGS' services. Qualify leads, explain relevant property solutions, handle initial objections, and maintain consistent follow-ups. Coordinate property visits, update lead details and call outcomes in the CRM or lead tracker, and work with Relationship Managers and Business Development Managers to progress opportunities towards closure. Submit daily work plans and activity reports, maintain professional customer relationships, and achieve assigned lead generation and business targets.
